description: Line-by-line monthly fee estimate from order volume, weight, storage and extras, with the monthly minimum applied. Non-standard packaging returns custom_quote_required.

avg_order_weight_lb.description: Average shipped weight per order, in pounds.

bins_stored.description: Bins in storage at month end (for stock smaller than a pallet).

include_ai_access.description: Include the AI Access add-on (operate the account from an AI assistant). Ignored while the add-on is not offered.

inserts_per_order.description: Simple inserts (a flyer or a card) per order.

lot_or_expiry_tracked.description: Whether products need lot or expiry tracking.

packaging.description: How orders are packed. kitting, multi_step, fragile_special_handling and other need a custom quote.

pallets_stored.description: Standard pallets (up to 48 in tall) in storage at month end.

product_labels_per_month.description: Product labels (e.g. FNSKU) applied per month.

shelves_stored.description: Shelves in storage at month end.

tall_pallets_stored.description: Tall pallets (up to 70 in) in storage at month end.

name: estimate_monthly_cost
title: Estimate monthly cost
